question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Upsetting
solution:
The correct answer is: **Perturbing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Upsetting **is an adjective that describes something that causes emotional distress, discomfort, or dissatisfaction. (परेशान)

 
 
• **For example**:- *The news of the accident was very upsetting for her family.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Perturbing **means causing someone to be anxious or unsettled. (व्याकुल करना)
 
• It is a synonym for upsetting.
 
 
• **For example**: *The news of the pandemic was perturbing for everyone.*
 
 

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dreamy **means having a magical or pleasantly unreal quality. (काल्पनिक)
 
• **Aware **means having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact. (जागरूक)
 
• **Amusing **means causing laughter or providing entertainment. (मनोरंजक)
